$description: Universal DS — token source of truth. DTCG-compliant. Consumed by Style Dictionary v4 to produce CSS variables, Tailwind preset, and TS objects. See architecture.md for human-readable model and palette.md for hex obvious justification. TIER-PREFIX CONVENTION (2026-05-27): top-level keys group by tier — `palette` / `spacing` / `radius` / `font` / `size` / `elevation` are PRIMITIVE-tier; `color` / `semanticSpacing` / `semanticRadius` / `semanticSize` / `typography` are SEMANTIC-tier; `button` / `input` / `card` are COMPONENT-tier. Style Dictionary build prefixes resolved variable names with `primitive/`, `semantic/`, `component/` accordingly when emitting Figma Variables and CSS (e.g. `--uds-primitive-palette-blue-600`, `--uds-semantic-color-background-primary-bold`, `--uds-component-button-background-primary-default`). Tier prefix is the FIRST signal a consumer sees — explicit by design, not optimization. Component tier is MANDATORY from day 1; isolation is a structural principle, not a population threshold. VISUAL HIERARCHY (0.3.0): `color.background.page` is the page-level off-white. `color.background.surface` is the elevated surface tone — sits one layer above `page`. TYPOGRAPHY ARCHITECTURE (2.0.0, 2026-05-27): `font` Tier 1 PRIMITIVE + `typography` Tier 2 SEMANTIC (Phase 5.7: 25 roles × 5 properties = 125 composites). SPACING + RADIUS 3-TIER (2.1.0, 2026-05-27 — Phase 2.1): `spacing` and `radius` Tier 1 PRIMITIVE; `semanticSpacing` and `semanticRadius` Tier 2 SEMANTIC. SIZING 3-TIER (3.6.0, 2026-05-31 — Phase 7.1.6): `size` Tier 1 PRIMITIVE (32 raw px values 0..720) + `semanticSize` Tier 2 SEMANTIC (60 intent roles across 9 families: icon / control-height / control-square / control-box / control-dimension / decoration / switch / container / arrow + focus-ring). Component-tier numeric hardcode discipline-gap CLOSED PERMANENTLY: 124 Component-tier vars rebound from raw numerics → semantic roles. Client lesson 7 (Component-tier off-scale acceptable) DEPRECATED. Strict 3-tier discipline now uniform across all 6 foundation categories (color / spacing / radius / typography / stroke / sizing). Spacing scale extended with intermediate roles `inset/2xs=6`, `inset/sm-plus=10`, `inset/lg-plus=20`, `inline/2xs=6`, `inline/sm-plus=10`, `stack/2xs=2`. Radius scale extended with intermediate roles `control/xs=2`, `control/md-plus=10`, `control/lg-plus=14`.

palette.$description: Tier 1 — Primitive colors. Not published as CSS vars directly. Used only in semantic aliases. See palette.md for full justification.

spacing.$description: Tier 1 PRIMITIVE spacing scale (raw values). Phase 2.1: named scale (none/2xs..6xl) replaces Phase 0 numeric scale. Phase 7.1.6 (2026-05-31): added 3 intermediate values (6/10/20) to close off-scale carve-outs at the semantic tier. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Primitive: Spacing` collection (15 vars). Tier 2 semantic spacing roles live under `semanticSpacing.*` below. Consumers never reference primitives directly — always go through semantic.

6.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — intermediate primitive between xs=4 and sm=8. Consumer: semantic/spacing/inset/2xs + semantic/spacing/inline/2xs. Not on the regular t-shirt scale step — explicit intermediate.

10.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — intermediate primitive between sm=8 and md=12. Consumer: semantic/spacing/inset/sm-plus + semantic/spacing/inline/sm-plus.

20.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — intermediate primitive between lg=16 and xl=24. Consumer: semantic/spacing/inset/lg-plus (Tabs lg item-padding-x).

semanticSpacing.$description: Tier 2 SEMANTIC spacing. Phase 2.1 (2026-05-27): added 4 categories × 5 sizes = 20 vars + 1 `none`. Phase 7.1.6 (2026-05-31): added 6 intermediate roles (inset/2xs=6, inset/sm-plus=10, inset/lg-plus=20, inline/2xs=6, inline/sm-plus=10, stack/2xs=2) to close off-scale carve-outs. 27 vars total. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Semantic: Spacing` collection. Categories: inset (paddings inside controls), stack (vertical gap between siblings), inline (horizontal gap between siblings), section (large layout gap between page sections). Each entry aliases a primitive. Consume from here, never from `spacing.*` primitives directly.

2xs.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 6 px intermediate inset (Badge sm padding-x, Input sm action-inset, Menu md padding). Between xs=4 and sm=8.

sm-plus.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 10 px intermediate inset. Between sm=8 and md=12. Currently unused at component-tier (reserved for future).

lg-plus.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 20 px intermediate inset (Tabs lg item-padding-x). Between lg=16 and xl=24.

2xs.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 2 px micro stack gap (Tooltip sm gap).
Phase 7.1.6 — 6 px intermediate inline gap (Input sm gap, Input header gap, Menu header padding-y). Between xs=4 and sm=8.

sm-plus.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 10 px intermediate inline gap (Input lg gap). Between sm=8 and md=12.

sm.$description: 32 — small layout gap (e.g. between sub-sections of one major section)

md.$description: 48 — default layout gap between page sections

radius.$description: Tier 1 PRIMITIVE radius scale (raw values). Phase 2.1: named scale (none/xs..2xl/full). Phase 7.1.6 (2026-05-31): added 2 intermediate values (10, 14) to close off-scale carve-outs at semantic tier. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Primitive: Radius` collection (10 vars). Tier 2 semantic radius roles live under `semanticRadius.*` below.

10.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — intermediate primitive between md=8 and lg=12. Consumer: semantic/radius/control/md-plus (SidebarItem badge + focus-ring radius).

14.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — intermediate primitive between lg=12 and xl=16. Consumer: semantic/radius/control/lg-plus (Switch focus-ring/md).

semanticRadius.$description: Tier 2 SEMANTIC radius. Phase 2.1 (2026-05-27): 3 categories ≈ 10 vars. Phase 7.1.6 (2026-05-31): added 3 intermediate control roles (xs=2, md-plus=10, lg-plus=14) to close off-scale carve-outs. 13 vars total. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Semantic: Radius` collection. Categories: control (small radii for buttons, inputs), surface (larger radii for cards, panels, dialogs), pill (fully rounded — badges, avatars). Consume from here, never from `radius.*` primitives directly.

xs.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 2 px micro control radius (SidebarItem indicator).

md-plus.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 10 px intermediate (SidebarItem badge + focus-ring). Between md=8 and lg=12.

lg-plus.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 14 px intermediate (Switch focus-ring/md). Between lg=12 and xl=16.

pill.$description: 9999 — fully rounded (avatar, switch knob, pill badge)

size.$description: Tier 1 PRIMITIVE sizing scale (raw values). Phase 7.1.6 (2026-05-31): introduced as 6th foundation category. 32 values 0..720 px covering ALL distinct dimensional values observed across DS: icon sizes (12/14/16/18/20/22/24/30), control heights (32/40/48), squares (20/24/32/40/48), control boxes (16/20/24), control dimensions (20/24/32/40/56), decoration micro-geometry (0/1/2/3/6/8/10/14), switch (28/36 etc.), sidebar widths (64/240), and container/overlay dimensions (200/240/280/320/400/480/560/640/720). Maps 1:1 to Figma `Primitive: Sizing` collection. Tier 2 semantic sizing roles live under `semanticSize.*` below. Consumers never reference primitives directly — always go through semantic per gate 7.10.

semanticSize.$description: Tier 2 SEMANTIC sizing. Phase 7.1.6 (2026-05-31): 60 vars across 9 role families. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Semantic: Sizing` collection. 9 families: (1) icon — 8 sizes covering all icon use cases; (2) control/height — 3 sizes (sm/md/lg = 32/40/48) for Input/Select/Menu-item/Tabs/Table-row/Sidebar-item heights; (3) control/square — 5 sizes (2xs..lg = 20..48) for IconButton; (4) control/box — 3 sizes (sm/md/lg = 16/20/24) for Checkbox visual box; (5) control/dimension — 5 sizes (xs..xl = 20/24/32/40/56) for Avatar; (6) decoration — dot 4 + dot-inset 3 + indicator 2 for Avatar status indicator + Tabs/Sidebar-item active indicator; (7) switch — 8 vars for Switch sm/md geometry; (8) container — 21 vars for Sidebar / Menu / Tooltip / Popover / Dialog / Drawer overlay + layout dimensions; (9) arrow + focus-ring — Tooltip arrow projection + focus-ring offset (shared across 8 components). Consume from here, never from `size.*` primitives directly per gate 7.10.

2xs.$description: 12 px — Badge sm/md icon, IconButton 2xs icon, Icon catalog 12, Input/Select/Menu-item sm icon, Checkbox sm icon, Avatar xs icon

xs.$description: 14 px — Badge md icon, Avatar sm icon

sm.$description: 16 px — Button sm icon, IconButton xs icon, Icon catalog 16, Input/Select/Menu-item sm icon (sub-family), Checkbox md icon

lg.$description: 20 px — Button md icon, IconButton sm icon, Icon catalog 20, Input/Select/Menu-item md+lg icon, Checkbox lg icon

2xl.$description: 24 px — Button lg icon, IconButton md+lg icon, Icon catalog 24, Input/Select/Menu-item lg icon

sm.$description: Input sm / Select sm / Menu-item sm / Tabs sm / Table row sm / Badge sm height (via aliasing control/square/2xs=20 — different)

md.$description: Input md / Select md / Menu-item md / Tabs md / Table row md / Sidebar-item / Badge md height (via aliasing control/square/xs=24 — different)

lg.$description: Input lg / Select lg / Menu-item lg / Tabs lg / Table row lg

2xs.$description: IconButton 2xs. Also: Badge sm height (20 px tall pill).

xs.$description: IconButton xs. Also: Badge md height (24 px tall pill).
Status-dot xs — Avatar xs/sm status indicator

sm.$description: Status-dot sm — Avatar md status indicator

md.$description: Status-dot md — Avatar lg status indicator

lg.$description: Status-dot lg — Avatar xl status indicator

none.$description: No inset — Avatar xs/sm/md status dot

sm.$description: Inset 1 px — Avatar lg status dot

md.$description: Inset 2 px — Avatar xl status dot

thumb-inset.$description: Switch sm thumb inset (2 px gap from track edge)

collapsed.$description: Sidebar collapsed width — 64 px icon-only rail

expanded.$description: Sidebar expanded width — 240 px label-visible rail

min.$description: Menu minimum width — ensures readable label width even with short items

sm.$description: Dialog sm max-width — narrow dialog for confirmations

lg.$description: Dialog lg max-width — wide content modal

offset.$description: Tooltip arrow reserved offset (unused in centered-arrow geometry)

Focus-ring offset — 2 px transparent gap between control bbox and focus-ring stroke. Shared by 8 components (Button / IconButton / Checkbox / Switch / Sidebar-item / Menu-item / Select / Tabs). Phase 7.1.6 — closes carve-out group of 8 hardcoded literals.

font.$description: Tier 1 PRIMITIVE typography (font-family / weight / size / line-height / letter-spacing scales). Tier 2 semantic typography lives under `typography.*` below (12 roles aliased to these primitives). Phase 2.0 brought this in line with Figma reality — top-level keys here emit as `primitive/font-*` in Figma Variables + `--uds-font-*` in CSS.

sans.$description: Loadable family name (Figma + CSS first reference). CSS export adds fallback stack: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif.

mono.$description: Loadable family name. CSS export adds fallback stack: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace.

size.$description: Named scale (replaces numbered scale.1..10 from Phase 0). 13 steps: 3xs..6xl + avatar-xl. Matches Figma Primitive: Typography collection 1:1. Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30) extensions catch up to Figma-side primitives created Phase 4.11: `3xs` (9 — Avatar-Initials xs floor); `avatar-xl` (22 — Avatar-Initials xl, off-scale midpoint between xl=20 and 2xl=24, name scoped to consumer per Figma side convention).

3xs.$description: Phase 5.7 — Avatar-Initials xs floor. Below 2xs=11; do NOT use for body/label text — semantic-only consumer is avatar-initials.xs. Matches Figma `primitive/font-size/3xs` (Phase 4.11).

avatar-xl.$description: Phase 5.7 — Avatar-Initials xl coupling. Off-scale midpoint between xl=20 and 2xl=24. Name scoped to consumer (`avatar-xl`, not generic `xl-plus`) per Figma-side convention created Phase 4.11. Avatar-Initials-specific; do NOT promote to general body/heading semantic.

line-height.$description: Pixel values (Figma stores LH in pixels per existing text-style format). Includes generic scale + heading-specific values aligned per role. Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30) extensions: `xs` (12 — Avatar-Initials xs LH, below `none`=16); `loose` (40 — Avatar-Initials lg LH, fills 40px container for vertical centering).

xs.$description: Phase 5.7 — Avatar-Initials xs LH. Smaller than `none`=16; sized-per-variant decoration.

loose.$description: Phase 5.7 — Avatar-Initials lg LH. Equals lg Avatar container height (40 px) — vertically centers single-char initials in the circle.

typography.$description: Tier 2 SEMANTIC typography. Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30): 25 roles × 5 properties = 125 composite values, each property aliasing a Tier 1 primitive. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Semantic: Typography` collection. Phase 5.6 added `caption.m` + `caption.s`. Phase 5.7 closed the remaining 11 Figma-side-only text styles: `caption.strong` (Inter Semi Bold 12/16/0), `label.strong` (Inter Semi Bold 11/16/0), `label.medium-tight` (Inter Medium 12/16/0), `heading.inline` (Inter Medium 16/24/0), `kbd.m` (JBM Regular 14/20/0), `kbd.s` (JBM Regular 12/16/0), `avatar-initials.{xs,sm,md,lg,xl}` (Inter Semi Bold, sized-per-Avatar-variant). Consume these — never primitives directly. UNBLOCKS frontend-dev rebinding of: Card title → caption.strong; Badge label → label.medium-tight; Input label sm → label.medium-tight; Input label lg → heading.inline; Input helper → caption.m; MenuItem label → caption.m; MenuItem kbd → kbd.{m,s}; Avatar initials → avatar-initials.{size}. AVATAR-INITIALS NOTE: 5 separate semantic roles (one per Avatar size variant) because font-size + line-height couple to Avatar dimension — Avatar sm uses sm, Avatar lg uses lg, etc. Avatar consumer chooses size based on Avatar variant prop. KBD NOTE: JetBrains Mono primitive (`font.family.mono`) — Kbd/{S,M} are the first semantic roles consuming mono family.

inline.$description: Phase 5.7 — Inter Medium 16/24/0. Inline heading variant for use within flowing content (e.g. Input lg label). Lower weight than H6 (medium 500 vs semibold 600) so it sits well next to body text without dominating.

strong.$description: Phase 5.7 — Inter Semi Bold 11/16/0. Strong-emphasis label at 11 px (Badge sm label heavy variant, status indicator). Distinct from Label/S (medium weight): bumps weight 500 → 600 for emphasis context. LS 0 — semibold at 11 px reads without extra tracking.

medium-tight.$description: Phase 5.7 — Inter Medium 12/16/0. Tight LS variant of Label/M (which uses LS +0.25). Used for Badge label (all sizes uniform), Input sm label. Distinct from Label/M by letter-spacing only — tighter reading for compact chrome where LS 0.25 produces visible gap.

caption.$description: Phase 5.6 (2026-05-29). Regular-weight counterparts of Label/M + Label/S — secondary/descriptive 11–12 px text. Distinct semantic role from Label (which is for actionable labels, weight 500). Use cases: Tooltip sm description (caption.s); Card metadata, Input helper text, Tooltip footnote (caption.m). Maps 1:1 to Figma `Caption/Small` + `Caption/Medium`. Letter-spacing 0 (not 0.25/0.5 like Label) — Inter Regular at 11–12 px reads naturally without extra tracking. Phase 5.7 added `caption.strong` — Semi Bold 12 px Card title binding.

strong.$description: Phase 5.7 — Inter Semi Bold 12/16/0. Card title binding. Same size as Caption/M but Semi Bold (600) for prominent caption (vs Regular 400 for descriptive).

kbd.$description: Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30) — JetBrains Mono keyboard shortcut hint family. 2 sizes: kbd.s (12/16) for compact contexts (Select kbd hint), kbd.m (14/20) for default (Menu / MenuItem kbd hint). LS 0 — mono renders cleanly without tracking. First semantic typography family to consume `font.family.mono` primitive.

avatar-initials.$description: Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30) — Inter Semi Bold initials sized-per-Avatar-variant. 5 separate semantic roles (xs / sm / md / lg / xl) — NOT a single role with prop because font-size + line-height couple to Avatar container dimension (LH equals container height for vertical centering of single-char initials). Consumer (Avatar React component) picks role based on `size` prop. Avatar dimensions: xs=20, sm=24, md=32, lg=40, xl=56 px. Sized-per-variant decoration class per client lesson 16 amendment (avatar-initials.xs requires font.line-height.xs=12 + font.size.3xs=9 primitives — both Phase 5.7-extended). Architectural note: lg LH=40 (= Avatar-lg dimension) and md/sm/xs/xl LHs equal or near container heights for consistent vertical centering. xl LH=32 is intentionally NOT 56 (would push initials baseline too low at this scale) — uses the same 32px LH as relaxed line-height.

shadow.$description: Tier 1 — PRIMITIVE shadow scale. 6 levels: none / xs / sm / md / lg / xl. Each value is a CSS box-shadow string. Phase 3.1 (Volna 2): expanded from pre-MVR `elevation.scale.0..5` numeric scale into named scale matching Spacing + Radius primitive conventions. Limitation: Figma Plugin API does not currently support EFFECT-typed variables — these shadow primitives are documented here for code-side consumers (Style Dictionary emits as CSS box-shadow), and Figma-side mirrored as native Effect Styles (`Primitive: Shadow / none..xl`) which serve the same role at the Figma side.

semanticShadow.$description: Tier 2 — SEMANTIC shadow roles. Phase 3.1 (Volna 2): introduced alongside Card component. Mirrors the 3-tier discipline applied to spacing / radius / color / typography uniformly across foundation categories (per universal lesson 'foundation 3-tier completeness'). Two role families: `elevation` for cards / surfaces in normal flow (resting state, sometimes hovered / floated), `overlay` for floating overlays (popovers, modals, tooltips, dropdowns). Figma-side mirrored as `Semantic: Shadow / {role} / {variant}` Effect Styles, each replicating the primitive's effect set (Figma cannot alias Effect Styles — replication is the only mechanism). Component-tier consumers reference these semantic roles by name (not by ID — effect styles bind by ID at the Figma side, by name in source).

sm.$description: Resting elevation for cards. Default for elevated Card.

md.$description: Hover-lifted card, dropdown menus, expanded panels.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips — small floating labels. Lower elevation than popovers.

modal.$description: Modal dialogs anchored to viewport center.

color.$description: Tier 2 — Semantic colors. Light theme values. Dark theme overrides in tokens.dark.json. ALL background tokens have paired text.on-* foreground (F-4).

page.$description: Page-level off-white. The bottom layer of the visual hierarchy. Used on root frame of every library page and on every product app page. Pair with `surface` for content containers — page = lower layer, surface = elevated layer above it. NEVER use page and surface on the same layer (no contrast). NEVER use page on a content card (looks like a transparent/missing frame). Renders as #F8FAFC in light / #020617 in dark.

surface.$description: Elevated content surface. One layer above `page`. Used on cards, sections, dialogs, dropdown menus, any content container that must read as a distinct surface. Always pair with subtle border for clean definition. Renders as #FFFFFF in light / #0F172A in dark.

raised.$description: Floating overlay surface — toasts, tooltips, popovers, dropdowns. One layer above `surface`. In light same hex as surface but with elevation shadow distinguishing it; in dark slate.800 (one step lighter than surface for chromatic lift).

transparent.$description: Named transparent background — semantic intent 'no visible surface, layout placeholder'. Consumed by component-tier tokens for ghost / danger-ghost / tertiary intents at default + focused + disabled + loading states. Distinguished from 'missing color' or 'unset' — explicit transparency communicates designer intent. Theme-invariant (same value in Light + Dark). Phase 6.0 (2026-05-30): added to replace hardcoded `#00000000` literals on 22 component-tier background variables in Figma.

overlay.$description: Modal backdrop / scrim — semi-transparent black layer that dims underlying page content when a modal overlay (Dialog, modal Drawer) is open. Light mode: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); Dark mode: rgba(0,0,0,0.6) — slightly darker to maintain perceived dim against already-dark page surface. Consumer: component/dialog/backdrop-bg + component/drawer/backdrop-bg. NOT consumed by Popover or Tooltip (they overlay without dimming). Phase 7.1 (2026-05-30): added with Volna 7 overlays bundle.

ghost.hovered.$description: Hover overlay for transparent/ghost surfaces. Mirrors background.subtle but named explicitly to read clearly in ghost-intent component tokens.

bold.$description: Anchor at 700 not 600 — green.600 on white fails AA (3.4:1). green.700 = 4.9:1 AA.

focused.$description: Renamed from `focus` to `focused` for state-naming consistency (hovered/pressed/focused/disabled). Drives the 2px focus ring on interactive components. F-8 critical.

transparent.$description: Named transparent border — semantic intent 'no visible border, structural placeholder'. Consumed by component-tier border tokens for primary / danger / ghost / danger-ghost intents at default + hovered + pressed + disabled + loading states (where the variant intentionally has no border but the slot exists for symmetric variant structure). Distinguished from 'missing color' or 'unset' — explicit transparency communicates designer intent and preserves geometric symmetry across intents (e.g. Button primary and Button secondary occupy identical bbox; primary's transparent border reserves the 1px line that secondary fills). Theme-invariant (same value in Light + Dark). Phase 6.0 (2026-05-30): added to replace hardcoded `#00000000` literals on 29 component-tier border variables in Figma.

button.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Button. 5 intents × 3 sizes × 6 states. All bg/text/border bound to Semantic: Color. Phase 2.1: padding/gap consume Semantic: Spacing (inset/inline roles), radius consumes Semantic: Radius (control role) — was direct Primitive consumption pre-Phase 2.1. Loading state reuses default visual tokens; spinner is a separate Spinner primitive. Disabled state shares bg/text across intents. Focused state overlays 2px focus ring.

offset.$description: Box-shadow inset offset to give the ring breathing room without shifting layout.

tertiary.$description: Subtle filled — primary-toned background at low emphasis. Sits between secondary (outlined) and ghost (transparent).

input.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Input. Phase 2.1: padding-x consumes Semantic: Spacing. Phase 7.1.6: all numeric hardcodes rebound to Semantic: Sizing + intermediate semantic/spacing roles. Zero hardcoded numerics remaining.

icon-size.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — icon size per Input variant aliased to semantic/size/icon. Mirrors Figma side.

action-inset.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — sm aliased to semantic/spacing/inset/2xs (6 px intermediate). md/lg = inset.xs (4 px).

gap.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — all gaps aliased to semantic/spacing/inline (xs/sm/sm-plus). sm/header use intermediate inline/2xs=6; md uses inline/sm=8; lg uses inline/sm-plus=10.

header.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 6 px label-to-input header gap aliased to inline/2xs.

card.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Card. Phase 3.1 (Volna 2): full token set built. Padding consumes Semantic: Spacing (inset role), radius consumes Semantic: Radius (surface role), shadow consumes Semantic: Shadow (elevation role).

elevated.$description: Elevated style shadow. Applied via Figma Effect Style `Semantic: Shadow / elevation / sm` at the Figma side.

badge.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Badge (Phase 3.1, Volna 2; Phase 7.1.6 — all geometry rebound to semantic sizing/spacing tiers, zero hardcoded numerics). Colors alias Semantic (style × intent combinations).

height.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 20 px height aliased to semantic/size/control/square/2xs (same primitive 20).
Phase 7.1.6 — 24 px height aliased to semantic/size/control/square/xs.

tooltip.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Tooltip (Phase 5.1, Volna 6; Phase 7.1.6 — all geometry rebound to semantic sizing/spacing tiers, zero hardcoded numerics). Colors alias Semantic. 13 tokens total.

padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding — tight overlay (8 px = inset.sm)

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding — less than horizontal for horizontal-emphasis shape (4 px = inset.xs)

gap.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 2 px aliased to semantic/spacing/stack/2xs (micro overlay-tight cadence).

size.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 6 px aliased to semantic/size/arrow/size. Arrow tip projection beyond body edge. Base 12 × depth 6 = 2:1 ratio.

offset.$description: Phase 7.1.6 — 8 px aliased to semantic/size/arrow/offset. Reserved for asymmetric arrow positions — unused in centered-arrow geometry.

bg.$description: Deep navy in Light mode — inverse surface for max contrast.

text.$description: White in Light mode — paired with bg for 7:1 contrast.

avatar.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Avatar (Phase 3.1, Volna 2; Phase 7.1.6 — all dimension/icon/status-dot rebound to semantic/size; font-size aliases primitive font.size due to Style Dictionary composite-typography dereference limit). Zero hardcoded numerics remaining.

font-size.$description: Phase 7.1.5 — aliased to primitive font.size.3xs (matches semantic/typography/avatar-initials/xs/font-size). Component-tier sticks to primitive alias because Style Dictionary build can't currently dereference composite typography sub-properties via {typography.x.fontSize} path.
Phase 7.1.5 — aliased to primitive font.size.2xs (matches avatar-initials.sm).
Phase 7.1.5 — aliased to primitive font.size.sm (matches avatar-initials.md).

Phase 7.1.5 — aliased to primitive font.size.md=16 (matches Figma side avatar-initials.lg chain → primitive/font-size/md=16; preserves the prior hardcoded canonical 16). Note: typography.avatar-initials.lg.fontSize in canonical resolves to {font.size.lg}=18, which is a pre-existing canonical drift vs Figma (16). Deferred — separate ratify.
Phase 7.1.5 — aliased to primitive font.size.avatar-xl (matches avatar-initials.xl).

dialog.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Dialog (Phase 7.1, Volna 7 overlays; Phase 7.1.6 — max-width aliases rebound to semantic/size/container/dialog). Centered modal — 3 size variants (sm 400 / md 560 / lg 720). All dimensions alias semantic. Effect: Semantic: Shadow / overlay / modal.

header-gap.$description: Stack gap between Title and Description in header — 4.

body-gap.$description: Stack gap between header / body / footer regions — 12.

footer-gap.$description: Inline gap between action buttons in footer — 8.

radius.$description: Surface radius — 12. Larger than control radius so the dialog reads as a major surface, not a control.

bg.$description: Dialog body background — surface tone (theme-aware via mode swap).

backdrop-bg.$description: Modal backdrop / scrim — dims underlying page so user attention focuses on dialog.

drawer.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Drawer (Phase 7.1, Volna 7 overlays; Phase 7.1.6 — all dimensions aliased to semantic/size/container/drawer). Edge-anchored sliding panel — 4 positions × 3 sizes = 12 variant cells. NO uniform radius token — corner rounding is per-position. Effect: Semantic: Shadow / overlay / modal.

padding.$description: Internal padding — 24, matches Dialog for consistency across overlay surfaces.

header-gap.$description: Stack gap between Title and Description — 4.

body-gap.$description: Stack gap between header / body / footer — 12.

backdrop-bg.$description: Modal backdrop — dims page when drawer is modal. May be omitted for non-modal drawers (consumer decision).

popover.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Popover (Phase 7.1, Volna 7 overlays; Phase 7.1.6 — all geometry rebound to semantic). Lightweight anchored interactive overlay — 4 positions × 2 sizes = 8 variant cells. Effect: Semantic: Shadow / overlay / popover. NO backdrop. border-width now aliases semantic/stroke/width/control.
